question: Can a phase- and occupancy-aware MILP improve tile selection on held-out matrix shapes without an L2 reuse term?
kernel: Unchanged BF16 WMMA family, 128 threads, single shared buffer, cyclic warp fragments

controlled_occupancy.purpose: Keep instructions and data fixed while changing residency with unused shared-memory reservation

confirmation_rule: Freeze coefficients and solver choices before measuring the full 144-tile confirmation domains
falsification: A worse held-out selection regret or no improvement in ordering rejects the claimed refinement; preserve negative evidence
constraints: No L2 term, no complete-tile performance lookup; physical memory traffic is diagnostic rather than presumed equal to requested bytes
timing: Existing cold-cache sweep, 9 groups of 5, GPU 7 only, sequential trials
status: preregistered before new calibration and confirmation measurements
